description: Global mic shortcut (Option+Space). The shortcut itself is registered in Rust (src-tauri/src/lib.rs), so the webview needs nothing to make it work: listening to the axe://sneltoets-mic event is already covered by core:default. Only is-registered is granted here, so a Settings screen can show whether the shortcut was actually claimed by the OS. NOTE: tauri.conf.json lists its capabilities inline, and a non-empty list means files in this folder are ignored unless referenced by identifier. Add "sneltoets" to app.security.capabilities to switch this on.
